name: Burning Red
source:
Hanna (Renameable MC) had gotten used to a quiet, mundane life, but she should've known it couldn't last for long. After being subjected to experiments by a dangerous group pushing the boundaries of science, she was lucky to escape relatively unscathed, but now they want her back.

The only thing between her and a return to a life of being a subject is a mysterious, masked man with uncertain motives.

Will he save her from her dangerous past, or be the catalyst for an even scarier future?

[From [url=https://lunamakaio.itch.io/burning-red]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
汉娜，名字可改，早已习惯平静而普通的生活，可她本该知道，这样的日子不会长久。她曾遭到一个不断突破科学界限的危险组织实验，幸运地逃了出来，身体也大致无恙。然而如今，他们想把她抓回去。

挡在她与重新沦为实验对象之间的，只有一个动机不明、戴着面具的神秘男人。

他会将她从危险的过去中救出，还是成为更恐怖未来的导火索？

[摘自[url=https://lunamakaio.itch.io/burning-red]itch.io[/url]]
